intro_j: Checks for every request: blacklist, known fakes, suspicious names and bios, bursts; then a captcha (if on) and the rule below. Requests Aegis received are listed for the admins.
guard_on: 🛡 Aegis is this channel's guard bot: the captcha opens as a Mini App.
guard_off: 🛡 Guard bot: not Aegis (the captcha goes to the requester's private chat, 5 minutes).
need_invite: ⚠️ Aegis needs «Invite users» to approve or decline requests and manage links.
guard_text: In Telegram's channel settings the owner can choose a bot that handles join requests. Choose Aegis there: requests then open a short captcha Mini App, and Aegis answers within the 10 seconds Telegram allows.
rq_gone: This request is no longer open.
m_note: Telegram doesn't let bots list a channel's subscribers: Aegis counts the joins and leaves it sees. Find someone by their account to check or remove them.
find_prompt: Choose the member with the button below, forward one of their messages, or send their numeric ID or @username.
need_ban: This needs the right to ban users.
intro_i: Links made here show how many joined or asked through each one. (Telegram doesn't let bots list links made elsewhere.)
i_none: No links made through Aegis yet.
new_link_intro: Tap an option to change it, then «Create». A link that needs approval can't have a member limit (Telegram's rule).
revoke_q: Revoke the link {name}? Nobody can join with it any more.
rename_prompt: Send the link's new name (up to {max} characters).
primary_none: Telegram didn't show a primary link.
primary_q: A new primary link stops the current one at once (useful if it leaked).
intro_q: Aegis watches people who join or ask to join for names and usernames that look like the channel or its admins, and removes or reports them. Known fake channels and accounts are blocked in the discussion group and direct messages.
fake_prompt: Send the fake's @username, t.me link or -100… id, or forward one of its posts.
fake_bad: That isn't a @username, a t.me link, an id or a forwarded post.
intro_a: Aegis tells the owner (and the log channel) when admins or their rights change, the title or photo changes, a post is edited, or Aegis's own rights change. Telegram doesn't tell bots when posts are deleted.
a_where_log: Alerts go to: the log channel and the owner's private chat.
a_where_owner: Alerts go to: the owner's private chat (set a log channel to keep them there too).
intro_d: The group where the channel's comments are. Its locks and security are its own (open its panel); here are the protections for comments.
d_none: This channel has no discussion group.
d_missing: ⚠️ Aegis isn't an admin there yet: add it, then the protections below work.
intro_h: If the channel accepts direct messages, Aegis can remove spam there: blocked senders, links, scams and dangerous files, known fakes and floods, and decline suggested posts with links.
h_seen: ✅ Aegis has seen the channel's direct messages chat.
h_unseen: Aegis hasn't seen a direct message yet.
h_need_right: ⚠️ Aegis needs «Manage direct messages» in the channel.
intro_e: A footer and link buttons added to every new post, posts that delete themselves, and options for posts published through Aegis.
prompt_footer: Send the footer added under every new post (up to {max} characters). Send «-» for none.
prompt_buttons: Send the buttons, one row per line: «Text - https://link» (several in a row with « | »). Send «-» for none.
need_edit: ⚠️ Aegis needs «Edit messages» for the footer and buttons.
